gaps.issue: The declared node/edge inventory can omit physically admissible contexts or routes.
gaps.counterexample: An omitted disconnected context has effect M while every inventoried component has zero effect.
gaps.corrected_now: Every bound is component/domain relative and omitted contexts force UNRESOLVED.

gaps.issue: A fitted or point-estimated edge difference is not a simultaneous valid upper certificate or proof of actual consumer use.
gaps.counterexample: A shadow kernel fits all calibration samples but the real consumer reads a bypass.
gaps.corrected_now: Structural or simultaneous upper validity and R167 route actuality are explicit premises.
gaps.unresolved_premise: Actual calibration data/specification and route-read audit.

gaps.issue: Uniform B takes a supremum over K0 and the factor-two bound can be too conservative.
gaps.counterexample: Only one intervention law varies along an edge, so 2D_B doubles the necessary pair-specific budget.
gaps.unresolved_premise: Whether tighter certificates are simultaneously valid for actual K0.

gaps.issue: Metric scale and L are not separately identified by envelope evidence.
gaps.counterexample: d'=100d and L'=L/100 reproduce every cone exactly.
gaps.corrected_now: Exact gauge node added; route budgets use d_F units.
gaps.unresolved_premise: Independent scientific justification of F and any coordinate normalization.

gaps.issue: A finite node graph does not cover unsampled continuum interiors or unseen fibers.
gaps.counterexample: Both endpoints have effect zero while an interior hidden gate has effect M.
gaps.corrected_now: Within-cell structural bounds or full finite enumeration are required; otherwise UNRESOLVED.
gaps.unresolved_premise: A finite structural cell/tube certificate or explicit open-world remainder.

gaps.issue: Calibration and challenge splits can share biases, and invalid lower bounds cannot refute an upper certificate.
gaps.counterexample: Both splits use the same miscalibrated sensor and miss an off-route change.
gaps.corrected_now: Same-object validity and independent challenge are explicit.
gaps.unresolved_premise: Actual sensor calibration, dependence model and lower-bound validity.

gaps.issue: Route certification does not establish complete neural organization, experiential identity or familiar mineness.
gaps.counterexample: A device route is fully certified but is only one nested relation within a larger unknown organism/device organization.
gaps.corrected_now: C1/B_min/basal/owner boundaries are retained in the node and rule.
gaps.unresolved_premise: Same-instance complete organization admission and independent B_min interpretation.
